page.layout: One scan showing the outside of a book binding, not a printed page: a pale vellum or parchment cover with a blind-tooled frame of double rules near the edges. No printed block.
page.notes: The scan shows the front board of a binding, not a leaf of text. Visible features: a blind-tooled double-rule border, two or three leather or cord tie remnants on the edges, an orange stain near the centre, and general staining and wear. Along the bottom edge there are faint marks that may be tooling or worn gilding, but none can be read as printed text. No title, running head, or page number is printed on the cover.
